svg.title: How the zip of a release is made and who checks it
svg.desc: From the signed tag, a job that may write nothing builds the zip. The isolated build of the release attests it and attaches it to the release, which is immutable once published. The workflow of the store takes the zip from the release, checks its provenance and its version without any secret, and hands on its sha256. A job that reaches only Google compares the bytes and uploads them, and Google reviews and publishes the version. Someone who loads the extension unpacked downloads the same zip and checks it with gh attestation verify. Anybody can build the zip again from the tag, and gets the same sha256.
